about: Shanghai Screw Compressor Company (SCR) manufactures electric motor driven high performance rotary screw air compressors along with a complete line of accessory items including air dryers, filters, and condensate remediation systems.

Express Engineering is a member of the Express Group of Companies, based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. We provide our customers with state-of-the-art solutions for their compressed air and power generation requirements.
